contextReview.basis: Direct review: overcast daytime East Asian urban streets with small tiled building walls, shop and cafe windows, canvas awnings, utility poles and stone paving; no rain depicted and reflective paving is not read as rain; white reflective details catch the direct flash; humidity not inferred. Mixed adult model casting is independent of the location.

casting.castingPolicy: mixed adult model appearance independent of the East Asian urban location (user 2026-11-03)

approval.evidence: Five editorials passed producer QA and continued under the user's standing workflow authorization (2026-11-03, "앞으로도 승인 없이 진행"); the user did not visually approve them individually. Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: No hand-held prop; the planters, cafe table and awnings are the setting. The raised hand covers part of the navy cap, and the back of the cap is inferred. The sage shell is worn open, with one arm raised and sleeves bunched: its back and hidden front are conservatively reconstructed. The black tee shows between the shell fronts. The black pants' waist is partly hidden. Black socks show above the white runners. Brand, fibre composition, performance and retail identity are unknown.

copy.titleEn: THE BRIM LIFTS IN THE WIND

title.en: The brim lifts in the wind
title.de: Der Schirm hebt sich im Wind

deck.ko: 세이지 쉘과 검정 팬츠의 가벼운 회복 걸음.
deck.en: A sage shell frames an easy recovery walk.
deck.de: Eine Salbeijacke begleitet den lockeren Erholungsschritt.

intro.ko: 바람에 들리는 모자 챙을 잡으며 어깨가 뒤로 돌아갑니다.
intro.en: A gust lifts the cap brim and turns her shoulder as she reaches to steady it.
intro.de: Eine Böe hebt den Capschirm und dreht beim Festhalten die Schulter.

body.ko: 열린 세이지 쉘 사이 검정 반팔 티가 보이고 긴 러닝 팬츠는 발목에서 모입니다. 네이비 캡과 검정 양말이 낮은 색 대비를 만들며 흰 러닝화가 발끝을 밝힙니다. 어깨의 흰 반사선과 직접 플래시가 회전한 상체의 주름을 분명하게 보여줍니다.
body.en: A black tee shows between the open sage shell edges, while long running pants gather at the ankles. Navy cap and black socks keep the contrast low, with white runners brightening the feet. White shoulder lines and direct flash define the folds across the turning torso.
body.de: Ein schwarzes Shirt zeigt sich zwischen offenen salbeifarbenen Jackenkanten, lange Laufhosen raffen sich am Knöchel. Marinecap und schwarze Socken halten den Kontrast niedrig, weiße Laufschuhe setzen helle Endpunkte. Weiße Schulterlinien und direkter Blitz zeichnen die Falten des gedrehten Oberkörpers klar.

pull.en: An open shell follows the shoulder turn.
pull.de: Die offene Jacke folgt der Schulterdrehung.

copy.pullQuoteEn: An open shell follows the shoulder turn.

tip.ko: 챙을 잡은 뒤 모자 조절 부분을 확인하고 팬츠 밑단이 뒤꿈치에 걸리지 않게 하세요.
tip.en: Check the cap adjustment after steadying the brim and keep pant hems clear of the heels.
tip.de: Nach dem Festhalten den Capsitz prüfen und die Hosensäume von den Fersen freihalten.

description.ko: 흰 어깨 반사선과 검정 옆 지퍼 포켓, 탄성 커프의 쉘입니다.
description.en: Shell with white shoulder reflective lines, black side zip pockets and elastic cuffs.
description.de: Jacke mit weißen Schulterreflexlinien, schwarzen Seitentaschenzips und Elastikbündchen.

howToWear.ko: 모자를 잡는 팔이 편하도록 커프를 가볍게 올리세요.
howToWear.en: Raise the cuffs lightly to free the arm steadying the cap.
howToWear.de: Die Bündchen leicht hochschieben und den Arm am Cap frei halten.
